description: Compares a snapshot against the live data model and reports the operations that applying it would perform. Read-only, nothing is modified, which makes it the safe way to preview a migration before apply_schema, the tool that consumes the { hash, diff } object returned here. mode mirror (default) includes deletions so the live model would end up matching the snapshot exactly; merge drops them for a strictly additive diff. force bypasses the Directus version and database vendor checks and risks producing a diff that cannot be applied. An empty diff means the model already matches.

force.description: Bypass the Directus version and database vendor checks

mode.description: 'mirror' (default) reports every operation including deletions; 'merge' excludes deletions for an additive diff.

snapshot.description: A snapshot as returned by get_schema_snapshot

name: diff_schema
